note: Speech delay and expressive speech impairment are consistently reported in SGSM3-related intellectual developmental disorder kindreds, though severity may vary.

evidence.text: Patients with homozygous SGSM3 variants in the index Ashkenazi Jewish kindred demonstrated speech involvement, including delayed speech acquisition and unclear speech into adulthood.

source.title: Intellectual disability syndrome associated with a homozygous founder variant in SGSM3 in Ashkenazi Jews
